name: Ditch Lurker
shortDescription: Peat and iron that learned to wait in black water.
lookDescription: Something peat-dark waits in the ditch, the size of a satchel, and does not swim away.
examineDescription: Black peat and old iron, about the size of a satchel, sitting in water too dark to see the bottom of. It is not a fish. Bright metal shows through the peat in two or three places, and none of it is bell-bronze.
lockNarration: Black water climbs the ditch lip and does not spill.
victoryNarration: The Ditch Lurker sinks into ordinary mud. The nail is all it kept.
